        agent_action.zero_crossings = []
        agent_action.prev_ax_sign = None
        agent_action.wind_period = None
        agent_action.wind_strength = None

    # Initialization phase: estimate wind parameters
    if not agent_action.initialized and step_count < 500:
        current_t = sandbox.get_sim_time()
        dt = current_t - agent_action.prev_t
        if dt > 0:
            ax = (vx - agent_action.prev_vx) / dt
            agent_action.accelerations.append(ax)

            current_ax_sign = 1 if ax > 0 else -1 if ax < 0 else 0
            if (agent_action.prev_ax_sign is not None and
                agent_action.prev_ax_sign != current_ax_sign and
                current_ax_sign != 0):
                agent_action.zero_crossings.append(current_t)

            agent_action.prev_ax_sign = current_ax_sign
            agent_action.prev_vx = vx
            agent_action.prev_t = current_t
        return

    # Finalize wind parameters after 500 steps
    elif not agent_action.initialized and step_count == 500:
        if len(agent_action.zero_crossings) >= 2:
            deltas = [agent_action.zero_crossings[i] - agent_action.zero_crossings[i-1]
